published_state_semantics.rule: Age>=2 birds observed at a colony before first breeding, without eggs/chicks at a nest, are pre-breeders; first observation guarding a nest with eggs or chicks defines breeder recruitment; later observed non-breeding seasons are non-breeder.

decision.next_required_action: Add USAP_DC_API_KEY, rerun schema-only workflow, record exact headers and parser receipt, then permit full behavioral-row download without changing the frozen choice model.

claim_boundary: No Ross Island settlement direction, effect size, event count, or significance has been observed.

Do not substitute the two-colony 600007 source for the frozen three-colony performance problem.
